#!/usr/bin/env node
// A stand-in for the herdr-projects CLI (test/review.test.mjs copies it to board.mjs and runs it): answers list --json and details from
// board.json beside it, logs every call to calls.log, and plays approve / stop / delegate on that state.
// board.json: { list: [...], details: { id: {...} }, onApprove: 'build' | 'stuck' | 'fail' | 'nothing' }
import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const dir = process.env.FAKE_BOARD_DIR || dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const file = join(dir, 'board.json')
const state = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
const [cmd, id, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2)
appendFileSync(join(dir, 'calls.log'), `${JSON.stringify([cmd, id, ...rest])}\n`)
const d = state.details?.[id]
const save = () => writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(state, null, 2))
const fail = (msg) => {
  console.error(msg)
  process.exit(1)
}

switch (cmd) {
  case 'list':
    console.log(JSON.stringify(state.list ?? []))
    break
  case 'details':
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    console.log(JSON.stringify(d))
    break
  case 'approve':
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    if (state.onApprove === 'fail') fail('refused')
    // Finished work that waits for its yes (stage approval): the board merges it.
    if (!d.plan) {
      d.task.stage = 'merging'
      save()
      break
    }
    d.plan.approvedAt = Date.now()
    if (state.onApprove === 'build') Object.assign(d.plan, { built: Date.now(), locked: false }), (d.task.stage = 'working')
    else if (state.onApprove === 'stuck') d.task.stage = 'working'
    else d.task.stage = 'starting'
    save()
    break
  case 'finish':
    // finish anyway: only a task that stopped without a summary; it goes back to the finish line
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    if (d.task.stage !== 'nosummary') fail(`${id} did not stop without a summary.`)
    d.task.stage = 'checking'
    save()
    break
  case 'tell':
  case 'retry':
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    break
  case 'stop':
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    d.task.stage = 'stopped'
    if (d.plan) d.plan.locked = false
    save()
    break
  case 'delegate':
    if (!d) fail(`no task ${id}`)
    if (d.plan?.approvedAt) Object.assign(d.plan, { built: Date.now(), locked: false })
    d.task.stage = 'working'
    save()
    break
  case 'add':
    // add <title> [options]: a new task, numbered after the last one
    state.added = [...(state.added ?? []), [id, ...rest]]
    save()
    console.log('added')
    break
  default:
    fail(`fake board: ${cmd}?`)
}
